SELECT DATE(o.identify_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM oil_car_handle o WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND o.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND o.identify_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND o.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(o.identify_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COUNT(o.id) AS count FROM oil_car_handle o LEFT JOIN station_info s ON o.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND o.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND o.identify_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND o.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY o.station_id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '未处理' OR o.status = '处理中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitHandleCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已关闭' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS handleCompleteRate FROM oil_car_handle o WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND o.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND o.identify_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND o.station_id = #{stationId}
